title: Windows Always On VPN — User Tunnel with Conditional Access (IKEv2/SSTP) via Intune
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (Always On VPN user tunnel via Intune VPN template; user certificate auth + Entra Conditional Access integration + trusted-network detection/split tunnel; single-tunnel scope, companion to the device-tunnel product).
Certificate lifecycle is covered in depth by the companion device-tunnel product; here the user-certificate profile is configured leanly and cross-referenced, not re-taught.
VPN gateway internals deferred to Microsoft docs.
